title: Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2027
last_action: Reported by the House Committee on Appropriations with H. Rept. 119-715 and committed to the Committee of the Whole House on the State of the Union.
status: Reported by House Appropriations; Union Calendar
summary: The House-reported FY2027 defense appropriations vehicle funds Department of Defense programs, including the research, testing, cybersecurity, and operational accounts through which military AI safeguards and implementation activities are carried out.
committee_dynamics: The bill is a central funding vehicle for defense AI implementation, but its amounts and report directions may change through floor action, continuing resolutions, or a consolidated appropriations agreement.
advance_rationale: Defense appropriations directly determine whether authorized AI testing, cybersecurity, and deployment safeguards receive operational funding.
verification_level: Bill identity and reported status checked against official congressional sources.
